metadata.protocol: Activate and inspect default 31 percent viewport before start marker. No concurrent build or verifier during measured interval. Debug fixture and offline verifier outside measured interval. Other desktop activity uncontrolled.
metadata.limits: First qualifying 128 tails, not unbiased samples; lifetime materialization counters include below-threshold batches. API timings not GPU execution, physical pen or first-visible-pixel proof. At most one viewport call shown per retained batch with total call count. Materialized duration sums separate calls. Do not mix workload variants.

limits: First qualifying retained rows, not unbiased samples or full distributions. Wake is mailbox observation, not producer wake. Signed offsets may carry older input across skipped/control batches. Helper threads are unobserved. API correlation is not artwork or visible-pixel proof.
